about: Highlights text inside a line, such as a search hit. The element has the mark role.

effect.about: `glow` adds a shadow around the highlight. `shine` moves a highlight across the text.
effect.title: Effects

motion.about: The animation a highlight enters with. Each one runs once when the highlight mounts.
motion.title: Motion

palette.about: Every look in every palette. The `text` look sets a heavier weight in place of a fill, for a highlight that has to be distinguishable without colour.
palette.title: Palettes and looks

radius.about: Every corner at every inline inset, in the subtle look.
radius.title: Corners and insets

title: Mark
